coverage_status_note: Sites located through their serving utilities and measured against the grid.
claims_absent_note: Measured from the grid up: every site located through the utility that actually serves it, then settled against nine years of federal meter data.

sites.note: confidence=medium. Article states the southeast Travis County Gigafactory site is inside Bluebonnet's service area and that the co-op has the legal responsibility to provide power. The Cortex AI training cluster sits on that same campus; ERCO/SCEN assigned from ERCOT's South Central weather zone.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
Site mapping is hand-curated from serving utilities, never inferred from state.
Annual matched claims are TRUE under the GHG Protocol market-based method. The verdict is 'true on paper, X physically', not an accusation.
